
```bash tab="pnpm"
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://jack-ui-ten.vercel.app/r/ai-landing-page.json
```

```bash tab="bun"
bunx shadcn@latest add https://jack-ui-ten.vercel.app/r/ai-landing-page.json
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `navbarProps` | `NavbarProps` | Configuration properties for the navigation header. |
| `heroProps` | `HeroProps` | Title, subtitle, CTAs, and background options for the Hero banner. |
| `logoCloudProps` | `LogoCloudProps` | Branding and integration logos to display. |
| `featuresProps` | `FeaturesProps` | Composed grid/list of product features. |
| `howItWorksProps` | `HowItWorksProps` | Setup flow or pipeline visual steps. |
| `pricingProps` | `PricingProps` | Subscriptions tiers, billing toggle and pricing. |
| `testimonialsProps` | `TestimonialsProps` | Customer validation quote grids. |
| `faqProps` | `FaqProps` | Interactive accordion with pre-packaged support questions. |
| `ctaProps` | `CtaProps` | The closing pitch section with a call-to-action button. |
| `footerProps` | `FooterProps` | The navigation links and copyright branding. |
